lines.cyr: Денеска ми е сабота, оф аман,
lines.lat: Deneska mi e sabota, of aman,

lines.cyr: Кираца ќ' оди на пазар, оф аман,
lines.lat: Kiraca ḱ' odi na pazar, of aman,
lines.en: Kiraca will go to the market, oh,

lines.cyr: Ќе ми го бара Наќета, оф аман,
lines.lat: Ḱe mi go bara Naḱeta, of aman,
lines.en: She will look for Nakje, oh,

lines.cyr: Наќе, море, братче ле, оф аман,
lines.lat: Naḱe, more, bratče le, of aman,

lines.cyr: кога ќе одиш во Влашко, оф аман,
lines.lat: koga ḱe odiš vo Vlaško, of aman,
lines.en: when you go to South Romania, oh,

lines.cyr: Ти мене абер да сториш, оф аман,
lines.lat: Ti mene aber da storiš, of aman,
lines.en: Will you let me know, oh,

lines.cyr: и јас ќе дојдам со тебе, оф аман,
lines.lat: i jas ḱe dojdam so tebe, of aman,
lines.en: and I will come with you, oh,
how much will you charge me?

lines.cyr: Кирацо, млада мори невесто, оф аман,
lines.lat: Kiraco, mlada mori nevesto, of aman,

lines.cyr: кирија ти е евтина, оф аман,
lines.lat: kirija ti e evtina, of aman,

lines.en: I do not take money from you.

lines.cyr: До Скопје, белото лице, оф аман,
lines.lat: Do Skopje, beloto lice, of aman,
lines.en: To Skopje, your white face, oh,

lines.cyr: до Белград, медно усте, оф аман,
lines.lat: do Belgrad, medno uste, of aman,
lines.en: to Belgrade, your honey lips, oh,
to South Romania, your tall body.
